prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a NEW original robot character concept for JARVIS, a small always-present desktop AI companion. The supplied PNG is a STYLE AND BRAND reference, not the shape to keep as the entire character. Evolve its visual language into an actual full-body robot with a head, torso, articulated arms, hands, legs and feet.
Design: sophisticated compact companion, about 2.8 heads tall, intelligent and quietly attentive, a sturdy precise silhouette that remains readable at 96–144 desktop pixels. A chamfered shield-shaped head echoes the reference contour; a glossy near-black visor has TWO calm luminous icy-blue eyes, subtle facial expressiveness, no mouth or human skin. Silver machined-metal brow and cheek plates, dark navy graphite inner frame. Moderately broad shoulders, compact tapering chest, clear waist, two clean forearm shells with small articulated hands, short mechanical legs and refined boots. Relaxed poised standby pose, one open hand slightly lifted in a restrained welcoming gesture, slight head tilt toward viewer.
Carry the existing silver J with its small four-point cyan star on a SMALL inset chest badge, preserving the supplied emblem identity as closely as possible; do not replace the brand with a random new symbol. The head and body must be unmistakably a robot, not a logo with eyes. Repeat only a few recognizable chamfered armor contours from the logo.
Materials/style: premium original hard-surface 3D product-character render, brushed cool silver titanium with clean broad surfaces, near-black/navy glossy insets, restrained cyan light seams. Layered modular shoulder/chest plates with small deliberate gaps that could later articulate and reassemble. Strong form hierarchy, mechanically plausible joints, no gratuitous bolts or cables, no weapons, no aggressive military proportions, no franchise character resemblance, no giant round plastic toy head. Quiet science-fiction intelligence rather than a battle mech.
Lighting: cool polished studio illumination, cyan edge glow kept close to the silhouette, gently luminous chest core, readable silver highlights on both dark and light desktop backgrounds.
Composition: ONE single full-body character, front three-quarter view, centered, entire hands and feet visible, generously padded on all sides, tall near-square composition. Float just slightly with no ground plane, no pedestal, no environment, no background, no opaque rectangle. Actual transparent RGBA background, clean antialiased silhouette, preserve soft local glow alpha. No text, no UI, no labels, no extra objects, no watermark.
This is a still visual design concept, not an animation.
scope: Still transparent robot shape concept. Original brand asset unchanged. No native implementation or animation delivered.
